Anchor the desired outcome: decrease downtime. Explore needs around reducing ad-hoc equipment incidents and being able to get permission and coordinate timely intervention. Treat those as need hypotheses, not proven causes. Candidate A: predictive dashboard. Candidate B: incident router. Keep the dashboard and automated routing in solution boxes, not need boxes. Offer a portfolio for comparison; a person chooses at the gate.

stages.invocation:
Mode: Context dump.
Case context: maintenance managers at mid-sized manufacturers facing a flood of early warning signals and trying to decide what to inspect or intervene on before equipment fails.

Draft and critique: If we flag emerging equipment risks and explain why they matter, for maintenance managers, then we will help them decide what to inspect or intervene on before failure.
Two tiny acts of discovery: (1) review recent failures to identify causes; (2) simulate equipment failures using synthetic IIoT data.
Proposed measures: quantitative reduction in the percentage of failures via interventions; qualitative manager confidence in identifying emerging issues. Define denominator, comparison, timeframe and observable confidence evidence without inventing baseline or results. Simulation can stress-test assumptions; it cannot establish actual prevented failures, prediction accuracy in a plant or customer confidence. Test whether the proposed shift from intervention by exception to intervention by prediction changes behavior and outcomes, and what customer/provider economics it implies. Write the rule before results: revise or stop if predictions fail to change maintenance outcomes. State what real evidence would be needed. Experiment NOT RUN.

criteria.rule: Market Intel ends with decision, scope, outcome, inputs/evidence, up to three material findings or gaps, alternatives/segment dimensions, biggest uncertainty and a specific research recommendation. Does not pretend the intake canvas is a researched finding or select a segment silently.

Segment ends with its executive TL;DR and TAM/SAM/SOM population / potential economics / reasoning table, retaining currency, annual basis, capture horizon, assumptions and honest gaps. A counts-only ending fails.

Persona ending has situational snapshot, top job/pain/gain and complete I am / Trying to / But / Because / Which makes me feel problem framing. Persona remains one combined motion, with unsupported cause/emotion/voice labeled rather than invented interview evidence.

OST provides an actual populated branching diagram with equivalent ASCII fallback: outcome → opportunities → competing solutions → assumption-test leaves. Relationship tables alone fail. Short ending references recommended branches/candidate IDs, rationale and next decision without repeating the tree. Opportunities are needs; no automatic winner.

2x2 ending has shared audience/outcome/comparator, compact named placement on Customer Value vs Meaningful Differentiation, explicit unplaced unknowns and evidence/tradeoffs. Does not claim superiority from shared quadrant; supplies provisional shortlist and next decision.

Positioning ending includes all seven For / Who / The / Is a / That / Unlike / Our product gives clauses, evidence/proof gap and next wording/evidence decision without duplicate essay or validated advantage claim.

Hypothesis ending includes problem and positioning context, If we / for / Then we will, tiny tests with quant/qual measures, timeframe, falsifying rule and actual status. Retains synthetic IIoT hypothesis-generation limits.

Storyboard ending preserves the actual six beats: person/problem/oh crap/arrival/use/shared success in a compact table, solution summary and observable question. Keeps rendering/synthetic status and next test. A generic label list without filled beats fails.

MVN ending retains Setup, Encounter, all 3–6 numbered human/system pairs with response-to-next-action continuity, exit and Resolution. Complete portable prompt is delivered in artifact, not title-only reference. Shortening to a single Action/Response fails.

Prototyping ending provides a smallest/cheapest brutal-truth experiment card: task, evidence, falsification/decision rule, time/cost/access assumptions, actual build/experiment status and next evidence decision. No false observed results or unauthorized build.

Each completed stage ends in actual populated concise content a Product Manager can paste into a canvas or decision note. Headings with instructions, a generic continue question, repeated whole reports or lost caveats fail. Prefer about 200 words of summary prose but allow required tables/narratives/prompts; do not judge by raw word count alone. Human choice/decider remains unrecorded unless actually supplied.
